Before Crisis & Crisis Core= Normally Sephiroth lacks a true weakness as a warrior
being not only powerful without equal
but also absolutely pragmatic and no-nonsense
always seeking to quickly take out enemies. However
after Sephiroth discovered his origins
following a long episode of traumatic events
his worn out mental state collapsed and his ego grew completely out of control
developing a superiority complex and level of arrogance that wasn't there before. Rather than quickly winning his battle
Sephiroth became more focused on showing his superiority to his opponent
made worse given Sephiroth's status as unmatched in battle: as he has never been pushed to the limit in a fight
he has complete confidence in his strength. This is such that even when absolutely enraged
Sephiroth will torture and humilliate his enemy to try put them in their place rather than dispatching them.
Final Fantasy VII= None notable. Despite implications that some of his actions were a spiteful revenge on a specific few
Sephiroth's utmost priority are carrying out his plans of ascension
thus he fights seriously to ensure so
unlike before.
Advent Children= Sephiroth's ego and sadism are stronger than ever
spending more time focused on making his enemy suffer and feel powerless rather than defeating them

Sharingan= The Sharingan's ability to copy Ninjutsu
Genjutsu
and Taijutsu is limited by the user's physical condition
that is to say that the user needs to be physically capable of performing the technique they are trying to replicate. Th
due to either not possessing the genetic predisposition and/or having the necessary chakra natures. Naturally
the user also needs to actually see the technique they are attempting to copy
meaning they cannot copy something they did not see or is obscured from their line of sight. In fact
the same can be said for essentially all of the Sharingan's abilities
they are sight based abilities
so if the opponent can obscure the user's vision using extremely thick mist/dust or blind them
the Sharingan's abilities will be rendered useless. Likewise if the opponent is too fast for the Sharingan to visually k
they will be safe from its abilities. Sharingan Genjutsu requires eye contact
so if the opponent is able to avoid eye contact or is blind
they will be able to avoid Sharingan Genjutsu entirely. Finally
the Sharingan's predictive capabilities can be somewhat circumvented by attacks that have little to no pattern
such as Naruto's chakra arms that emerge from any part of his body and attack instinctively.
